CREATE INDEX idx_check_items_profile_type ON check_items(profile_id, task_type, enabled, sort_order)

CREATE INDEX idx_report_review_events_item
            ON report_review_events(task_id, result_code, item_id, id)

CREATE INDEX idx_report_suppression_hits_rule
            ON report_suppression_hits(rule_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_report_suppression_rules_enabled_type_updated ON report_suppression_rules(task_type, updated_at) WHERE enabled = 1

CREATE INDEX idx_report_suppression_rules_lookup
            ON report_suppression_rules(task_type, check_code, fingerprint, enabled)
CREATE INDEX idx_suppression_profile ON report_suppression_rules(profile_id, task_type, check_code) WHERE enabled = 1

CREATE INDEX idx_suppression_reviews_pending
            ON report_suppression_reviews(source_task_id) WHERE needs_validation = 1

CREATE INDEX idx_suppression_reviews_rule
            ON report_suppression_reviews(rule_id, is_current, needs_validation)

CREATE INDEX idx_suppression_reviews_source
            ON report_suppression_reviews(source_task_id, source_result_code, source_item_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_ip_created ON tasks(ip, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_owner_created ON tasks(owner_subject, created_at DESC)

CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_pending_file_cleanup ON tasks(source_files_cleaned_at, COALESCE(finished_at, updated_at, created_at), id) WHERE source_files_cleaned_at IS NULL AND status IN ('completed', 'partial', 'failed', 'canceled')
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status_created_id ON tasks(status, created_at ASC, id ASC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status_lease ON tasks(status, lease_expires_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status_owner ON tasks(status, owner_subject)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status_owner_created_id ON tasks(status, owner_subject, created_at ASC, id ASC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tasks_submission_token ON tasks(task_type, owner_subject, submission_token) WHERE submission_token IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_type_created ON tasks(task_type, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_type_owner_created ON tasks(task_type, owner_subject, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_type_owner_status ON tasks(task_type, owner_subject, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_type_status ON tasks(task_type, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_user_model_configs_provider ON user_model_configs(provider_id, sort_order ASC, id ASC)
CREATE INDEX idx_user_model_providers_owner ON user_model_providers(owner_subject, updated_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_user_product_domains_domain ON user_product_domains(domain_id, subject)

CREATE TABLE check_item_aliases (
        profile_id TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL, canonical_code TEXT NOT NULL,
        check_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile_id, code)
    )

CREATE TABLE "check_items" (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            profile_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
            task_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'document_check', code TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
            enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, default_selected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, pool_item_id INTEGER, template_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', check_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prompt', skill_package_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            UNIQUE(profile_id, code)
        )

CREATE TABLE check_profile_items (
        profile_id TEXT NOT NULL, check_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(profile_id, check_item_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE check_profiles (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        template_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE ip_usernames (
            ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            username TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE product_domains (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            name_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE report_review_events (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            result_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            stage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(stage IN ('initial', 'final')),
            decision TEXT NOT NULL,
            note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            actor_subject TEXT NOT NULL,
            actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            actor_source TEXT NOT NULL,
            channel TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            acceptance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            initial_review_id INTEGER,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE report_suppression_hits (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            rule_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            result_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(rule_id) REFERENCES report_suppression_rules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            UNIQUE(rule_id, task_id, result_code, item_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE report_suppression_reviews (
            final_review_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            rule_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES report_suppression_rules(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            source_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            source_result_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            is_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            needs_validation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        )

CREATE TABLE report_suppression_rules (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            task_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            check_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            reason TEXT,
            enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            source_task_id INTEGER,
            source_result_code TEXT,
            source_item_id TEXT,
            hit_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            last_hit_at TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, profile_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
            UNIQUE(task_type, check_code, fingerprint)
        )

CREATE TABLE settings (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            value TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE task_final_review_stats (
            task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            total INTEGER NOT NULL,
            initial_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
            required_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL,
            returned INTEGER NOT NULL,
            deferred INTEGER NOT NULL,
            pending INTEGER NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE task_live_results (
            task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            result_json TEXT,
            summary TEXT,
            progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE task_report_stats (
            task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            suppression_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            issue_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            suggestion_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            non_issue_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            accepted_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            rejected_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            suppressed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            reviewed_item_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            pending_review_item_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE tasks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            task_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'document_check',
            ip TEXT NOT NULL,
            username_snapshot TEXT,
            owner_subject TEXT,
            owner_name_snapshot TEXT,
            owner_source TEXT,
            submission_token TEXT,
            original_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
            stored_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
            file_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
            document_text TEXT,
            document_meta_json TEXT,
            checks_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            checks_snapshot_json TEXT,
            retry_check_codes_json TEXT,
            provider_id INTEGER,
            provider_name TEXT,
            model_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            api_base TEXT NOT NULL,
            api_key TEXT,
            request_timeout INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 600,
            max_input_chars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80000,
            force_disable_thinking INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            reasoning_effort TEXT,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
            progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            claim_token TEXT,
            lease_expires_at TEXT,
            result_json TEXT,
            summary TEXT,
            error TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            started_at TEXT,
            finished_at TEXT,
            source_files_cleaned_at TEXT
        , check_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', check_profile_snapshot_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE user_identities (
            subject TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE user_model_configs (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            provider_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            model_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            force_disable_thinking INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            reasoning_effort TEXT,
            sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES user_model_providers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            UNIQUE(provider_id, model_name, force_disable_thinking)
        )

CREATE TABLE user_model_providers (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            owner_subject TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            api_base TEXT NOT NULL,
            api_key TEXT,
            request_timeout INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 600,
            max_input_chars INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500000,
            is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE user_permissions (
            subject TEXT NOT NULL,
            permission TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(permission IN (
                'tasks.view_all', 'tasks.manage_all', 'stats.view_all', 'rules.manage',
                'reports.final_review'
            )),
            PRIMARY KEY(subject, permission),
            FOREIGN KEY(subject) REFERENCES user_identities(subject) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TABLE user_product_domains (
            subject TEXT NOT NULL,
            domain_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            assigned_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(subject, domain_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(subject) REFERENCES user_identities(subject) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(domain_id) REFERENCES product_domains(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )

CREATE TRIGGER trg_check_item_pool_delete
        AFTER DELETE ON check_items BEGIN
            DELETE FROM check_profile_items WHERE check_item_id = OLD.id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_check_item_pool_identity
        AFTER INSERT ON check_items WHEN NEW.pool_item_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE check_items SET pool_item_id = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_check_profile_delete
            BEFORE DELETE ON check_items
            WHEN OLD.task_type = 'document_check' BEGIN
                UPDATE check_profiles SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = OLD.updated_at
                WHERE id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM check_profile_items WHERE check_item_id = OLD.id);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_check_profile_insert
            AFTER INSERT ON check_items
            WHEN NEW.task_type = 'document_check' BEGIN
                UPDATE check_profiles SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NEW.updated_at
                WHERE id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM check_profile_items WHERE check_item_id = NEW.id);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_check_profile_update
            AFTER UPDATE ON check_items
            WHEN NEW.task_type = 'document_check' BEGIN
                UPDATE check_profiles SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = NEW.updated_at
                WHERE id IN (SELECT profile_id FROM check_profile_items WHERE check_item_id = NEW.id);
            END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_review_events_stats_invalidate
        AFTER INSERT ON report_review_events
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM task_final_review_stats WHERE task_id = NEW.task_id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_suppression_reviews_report_changed
        AFTER UPDATE OF result_json ON tasks
        BEGIN
            UPDATE report_suppression_reviews SET needs_validation = 1
            WHERE source_task_id = NEW.id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_suppression_reviews_review_changed
        AFTER INSERT ON report_review_events
        BEGIN
            UPDATE report_suppression_reviews SET needs_validation = 1
            WHERE source_task_id = NEW.task_id
              AND source_result_code = NEW.result_code AND source_item_id = NEW.item_id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_suppression_reviews_task_deleted
        BEFORE DELETE ON tasks
        BEGIN
            UPDATE report_suppression_reviews SET needs_validation = 1
            WHERE source_task_id = OLD.id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_tasks_final_review_stats_invalidate
        AFTER UPDATE OF result_json, status ON tasks
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM task_final_review_stats WHERE task_id = NEW.id;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_tasks_report_stats_invalidate
        AFTER UPDATE OF result_json ON tasks
        BEGIN
            DELETE FROM task_report_stats WHERE task_id = NEW.id;
        END
